note: Every entry points at a file under custody in this repository. Confidences are copied verbatim from each run's own confidence JSON, and every value in `screen` is copied from study #10's artefact. FOUR things are derived here and are the only ones: `interface_pae` (mean and minimum PAE across the two chains, from the retained array), `chains[].mean_plddt` (a mean over the B-factor column), `screen.decoy_mean_beats_native` (a comparison of two copied values, which the study did not make) and the `coverage` counts. An earlier version of this sentence said exactly one quantity was derived, which was wrong by three.

coverage.note: Not every catalogued candidate has a fold, and the reasons do not cover all of them. Of the 13 catalogued candidates with no fold at all: 4 fail sequence validation and were never submitted to a predictor; 5 carry a sequence that is byte-identical to one that WAS folded, so the computation exists under another code; and 4 are valid, carry a sequence nothing else shares, and were simply never folded -- CogAbeta-Clearer-08, CogBDNF-Mimic-04, CogDual-TrkB-PAS-10, CogTrk-DeNovo-01. That last group is an omission, not a policy, and is stated rather than absorbed into the first two.
coverage.complex_group_is_study_10: The 13 complexes are not a selection from the 22 peptides -- they ARE study #10's native rows, so the decomposition is: of 35 catalogued candidates, 21 were never nominated for a receptor complex at all (they appear in no target map, so no complex was ever attempted for them), 1 was dropped by the screen's de-duplication on (peptide, target) because an earlier code carries the identical pair (BasalAChE-GorgeBlock-B1), and the rest were folded. The earlier wording said five codes were de-duplication casualties; one is, and the other four share a peptide with a folded complex against a DIFFERENT target, which is a different situation and was being counted as the same one.

not_indexed.decoys: Each complex has 10 composition-matched scrambles under custody. They are excluded from this picker on purpose: several score above their own native, and letting a reader browse for the best-looking fold is the error the null exists to prevent.
